name: newsletter-section
title: Newsletter section
description: Newsletter band: a section heading beside a ringed card with an email field, a black pill, and a confirmation state.
usage: A newsletter or updates sign up near the foot of a page. `onSubmit` receives the trimmed address once it is valid (Field shows "Enter your email." or the invalid message under the input); resolve to swap in the confirmation, or throw an Error to show its message. `privacy` is the line under the form.
avoid: A popup or modal sign up
notes:
Derived, not ported: the brand's site has no newsletter form. It is composed from library items only: a SiteSection
with SectionHeading, the contact page's ringed card, and Field, Input and the `pill` Button.

reference.scope: Derived, not ported: the brand has no counterpart. Composed from library items section, contact-page, field, input, button.
